title: English Practice Quiz 0128
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
You ___ wear your identity card at work.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs such as should are followed by the base verb without to.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.
